ruleDefinitions.name: Cleartext Protocol Usage Via Netflow
ruleDefinitions.description:
Ensure that all account usernames and authentication credentials are transmitted across networks using encrypted channels
Ensure that an encryption is used for all sensitive information in transit.
Ensure that an encrypted channels is used for all administrative account access.

sequences.query: (dest_port = 8080 OR dest_port = 21 OR dest_port = 80 OR dest_port = 23 OR dest_port = 50000 OR dest_port = 1521 OR dest_port = 27017 OR dest_port = 1433 OR dest_port = 11211 OR dest_port = 3306 OR dest_port = 15672 OR dest_port = 5900 OR dest_port = 5901 OR dest_port = 5902 OR dest_port = 5903 OR dest_port = 5904)
